index.html:
哪些早已知道？這次又看到了什麼？

公開資料已知的事這次實測補充了什麼
TranslateGemma 以 Gemma 3 為基礎，專門訓練翻譯；官方多語測試並不是台灣心理健康英中翻譯測試。本批資料中，Gemma 4 12B、26B 與 31B 的文字平均分都高於 TranslateGemma 27B。但世代、量化與模板不同，不能說「通用模型一定比翻譯模型好」。
Gemma 4 26B A4B 只啟用部分專家參數；追求效率的架構設計已是公開資訊。本次測到 26B 與 31B 的文字平均分只差 0.083 分，回應時間中位數分別是 0.686 與 2.511 秒。新資訊是這批領域素材的實測組合，不是首次發現 MoE 較有效率。
LLM 評審可能受順序與偏好影響；評審一致不等於答案正確。本次逐一移除評審，文字與圖片各自的前三名順序都維持；但也找到一則與台灣官方用語不符的術語批評。比較穩定與個別誤判可以同時存在。

以上稱為「本次值得注意的觀察」，不宣稱全球首創、普遍優勢或統計顯著。

依據：Google TranslateGemma · Gemma 4 model card · LLM-as-a-Judge / MT-Bench
methods.html:
連評審也需要被查核：一個實例

Gemma 4 31B QAT 的 text-06 使用「雙相情緒障礙症」。Mistral 評審認為「情緒」不標準、必須用「情感」，但健保署資料與臺大醫院新竹分院均使用「雙相情緒障礙症」。因此，這項絕對化的批評不能當成已證實的模型錯誤。原始評分完整保留；這是發布時新增的外部查核註記，不是補做一套人工評分。

Taiwan NHI terminology · National Taiwan University Hospital, Hsinchu

重現註解與查核修正

翻譯端：context 8,192、輸出上限 4,096、關閉 thinking、temperature 0、seed 20261023。本機評審端：context 32,768、輸出上限 16,384、reasoning budget 8,192。原始概括重現說明混用了兩者；本網站依設定及執行紀錄分開交代。

A/B 與 B/A 順序檢查：168 組受支援配對（336 個方向）中，112 組一致、7 組一致平手、49 組順序不一致而棄權。另 12 組 Mistral 圖片配對是設計上不支援。配對並未涵蓋所有模型組合，不能推導完整勝率排行榜。

index-en.html:
Known context—and what this test adds

Established evidenceWhat this run adds
TranslateGemma is translation-specialized and built on Gemma 3. Its published broad-language benchmarks are not this Taiwan mental-health test.In this fixed English-to-Traditional-Chinese sample, Gemma 4 12B, 26B and 31B have higher text-panel means than TranslateGemma 27B. Different generations, quantization and templates prevent attributing the gap to specialization alone.
Gemma 4 26B A4B uses sparse expert activation; its efficiency-oriented design is already public.Here, 26B and 31B differ by only 0.083 text-panel points, while median warm request times are 0.686 s and 2.511 s. These are measurements of this setup, not a new discovery about MoE architecture.
LLM judges can exhibit position and preference biases. Agreement does not establish correctness.The top three remain the same when any one eligible judge is omitted, yet an actual Taiwan terminology criticism conflicts with official usage. Stable rankings and a wrong annotation can coexist.

These are observations from one frozen test, not claims of scientific priority or universal superiority.

Sources: Google TranslateGemma · Gemma 4 model card · LLM-as-a-Judge / MT-Bench
methods-en.html:
An example where the judge needs checking

For Gemma 4 31B QAT, text-06, Mistral called 雙相情緒障礙症 non-standard and insisted on 情感. Taiwan’s NHI and a national university hospital use 雙相情緒障礙症. The categorical criticism is therefore not accepted as a demonstrated model error. The archived score is unchanged; this external check is an editorial annotation, not a new human-scored dataset.

Taiwan NHI terminology · National Taiwan University Hospital, Hsinchu

Reproduction notes and audit corrections

Translation: context 8,192; output limit 4,096; thinking off; temperature 0; seed 20261023. Local judges: context 32,768; output limit 16,384; reasoning budget 8,192. The original general reproducibility note mixed these tracks; this site separates them using the configuration and runtime records.

Paired-order checks: 168 supported pairs (336 directions), comprising 112 consistent decisions, 7 consistent ties and 49 order-inconsistent abstentions. Another 12 Mistral image pairs were unsupported by design. This sparse comparison graph does not justify an all-model win-rate ranking.
